general.description: Core LCD4Linux settings: which backend/driver to use, device path, display dimensions, font, update frequency, and orientation.

general.backend.description: LCD driver backend (e.g., FBv5, G15, G19, HD44780, LCD2USB, SerialLCD, USBHID, X11).

general.device.description: Device path (e.g., framebuffer, serial port, USB device).

general.width.description: Display width in pixels (or characters for text-only displays).

general.font.description: Font name for text rendering (must be loadable by the backend).

general.flip_y.description: Flip the display vertically (useful for inverted mounting).

layout.description: Layout for each LCD line (rows 1–4). For 4-line displays, rows 5–8 are optional.

layout.row1.description: Content for the first line (supports widgets like $date, $time, $hostname, etc.).

layout.extra_rows.description: Optional rows 5–8 (list of up to 4 strings). Only used on 8-line displays.

widgets.description: List of widget definitions. Each widget provides dynamic data to the display (e.g., CPU, memory, network).

name.description: Unique widget identifier (used as [Widget.name] section header).

type.description: Widget type (e.g., Text, Bar, Icon, Graph).

driver.description: Backend driver name (e.g., FBv5, X11) if widget is driver-specific.

align.description: Text alignment: left, center, or right.

width.description: Width in pixels/characters (optional, depends on widget type).

update_interval.description: Widget-specific update interval (ms), overriding the global one.

color.description: Text/foreground color in hex or name (e.g., #FFFFFF, white).

bgcolor.description: Background color in hex or name.

font.description: Override default font for this widget.

source.description: Data source (e.g., file path, command, or internal variable like 'cpu.usage').

oneline.description: Force single-line display (e.g., for scrollable text).
